# Introduction {.unnumbered}

Welcome to Unit 1! Here you learn to show data with pictures and to describe it with a few numbers.

A list of 30 numbers is hard to read. A good graph shows the whole story at once.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Make and read frequency tables, dot plots, and histograms
* Find the mean and the median
* Tell how the shape of a graph changes the mean
* Find quartiles and the IQR
* Make and read box plots
* Find outliers with the 1.5 × IQR rule

This unit matches **Unit 1: Displaying a single quantitative variable** in Khan Academy's Statistics essentials.

***

## Topics in This Unit

[**Frequency Tables, Dot Plots & Histograms**](1.1_Frequency_Tables_Dot_Plots_and_Histograms.qmd)\
Count data, then show it with a table, a dot plot, or a histogram.

[**Mean, Median & Shape**](1.2_Mean_Median_and_Shape.qmd)\
Find the center of the data. See how a long tail pulls the mean.

[**Quartiles, IQR & Box Plots**](1.3_Quartiles_IQR_and_Box_Plots.qmd)\
Cut the data into four parts and draw a box plot.

[**Reading Box Plots & Outliers**](1.4_Reading_Box_Plots_and_Outliers.qmd)\
Read a box plot and find values that are far from the rest.

[**Unit 1 Review**](Review.qmd)\
Practice every skill from the unit before the quiz.
